liebermann.notes: Pontifical for an archbishop of Canterbury, with the coronation oath in the consecratio regis (p. 278) and Iudicium Dei IX and I–III; most closely related to Rj and Vt.

entries.text_de:
Cambridge Corpus Christi College 44, Pontifical für einen Erzbischof von Canterbury um 1040—805.

p. 278 Incipit consecratio regis, darin Sacr cor, u. S. 215.

p. 362 Iud Dei IX; p. 365 Iud Dei I—III, u. S. 416. 401. Nächst verwandt mit Rj Vt.
entries.text_en:
Cambridge Corpus Christi College 44, pontifical for an archbishop of Canterbury, c. 1040—805.

p. 278 Incipit consecratio regis, containing Sacr cor, below, p. 215.

p. 362 Iud Dei IX; p. 365 Iud Dei I—III, below, pp. 416. 401. Most closely related to Rj Vt.

notes.text_de: vgl. Wanley 109; Henderson Liber pontif. Ebor. p. xxi; Legg Three coronation orders p. xxxviij, wo tab. 3 Facsimile; Warren Leofric missal 102.
notes.text_en: cf. Wanley 109; Henderson, Liber pontif. Ebor. p. xxi; Legg, Three coronation orders p. xxxviij, where plate 3 is a facsimile; Warren, Leofric missal 102.

transcription.doubts: Small-capital roman numerals in n. 5 (xxi, xxxviij) given in lower case.
